{{Quote|Alchemy should have no part in a Je'daii's experience. It is a dark force, arcane and dangerous. It has the power to upset balance. There are other ways.|Vor'Dana, 10,456 TYA|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,997 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,456 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Vor'Dana]] was serving as the [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Stav Kesh]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
